title: Under 16 concurrent publishers the hub change feed stays contiguous and a reader following it sees every change once
steps: S1: 16 publishers append 10 changes each through appendChange while a reader pages the changes feed from the head.
expect: S1: positions 1..160 without a gap; the reader saw the 160 changes once each, in position order.
evidence: Measurement added for the counter row; throughput numbers come from the bench script, not this case
fence: wo_hub_append_change takes the next position from one locked counter row held until commit
